questions.text: Which shell has the highest electron binding energy in tungsten?
questions.explanation: The K shell is closest to the nucleus, so its electrons are the most tightly bound.
questions.source: Original question; verify against standard physics texts

questions.text: Which process produces most of the diagnostic x-ray beam spectrum?
questions.explanation: Bremsstrahlung gives the continuous spectrum and dominates the diagnostic beam.
questions.source: Original question; verify against standard physics texts

questions.text: Increasing kVp (all else equal) mainly does what to the beam?
questions.explanation: Higher kVp raises maximum and mean photon energy and increases output (roughly with kVp squared).
questions.source: Original question; verify against standard physics texts
options: Increases beam quantity and mean energy

questions.text: Photoelectric absorption probability varies approximately as:
questions.explanation: Probability scales roughly with Z cubed and inversely with E cubed, giving bone/soft-tissue contrast at low kVp.
